title: Google Map Search Results
text:
## Google Map Search Results
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000052778

## Overview
The Google Map Search Results add-on will allow the website to have search results on the front-end of the website displayed on an interactive Google Map.
By default the website displays search results for members, posts and more in a list layout. With this add-on, choose to display these search results on an interactive Google Map.
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually: Google Map Search Results Add-On

## Enabling the Add-On
1. Go to Settings - Design Settings. Within the Design Settings tab, scroll down until the admin sees the Search Results Pages option:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091955158/original/pY-WwD3n-to8Mx0p5QeCWqQI_KKxXVo3rw.png?1619654984 | alt: ]
2. Expand and make sure to enable it here:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091955255/original/si4JYzgbnWaT5lK5_ru-oOgqbL0xWBygbA.png?1619655182 | alt: ]
